subject: Ephemeral headroom sponsorship and pricing fallback
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin@bento-retail.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@cloudops.io>; contracts@bento-retail.com
Date: 2028-04-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity — temporary headroom ask

Hi Ava —

Quick note from launch ops: we expect a 48-hour burst on April 10–11 where our token usage could spike ~6x baseline. Legal wants clarity on three things before sign-off:

1) Can Redwood provide a short-duration headroom that is billed separately (we prefer a one-time sponsored credit vs. permanent quota bump)?
2) What overrun rate would apply if we exceed the sponsored amount?
3) Is there an automated fallback model (lower-cost variant) that preserves latency for critical paths?

We’re hoping for a commercial path that avoids a long-term commit increase — this is purely ephemeral. If helpful, Samir from CloudOps is on this thread and can share usage projections.

Thanks,
Erin
Erin Walsh
Head of Product Ops
Bento Retail

Attachment: launch_projection_apr10-11.csv (text/csv, 78 KB)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin@bento-retail.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@cloudops.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity — temporary headroom ask

Hi Erin —

Thanks for the context. High level response inline below and a proposed commercial structure. Short answer: yes — we can do a time-limited headroom arrangement with a capped overrun rate and an optional automated fallback to a compatible model variant.

Proposal (ephemeral headroom sponsorship):
- Duration: 48 hours (April 10 00:00 UTC to April 11 23:59 UTC)
- Sponsored units: 1.5M tokens (one-time credit) — Redwood will apply as a post-period credit line item if not used.
- Overage: $0.015 / 1k tokens above the sponsored units during the window (flat rate; no tiering for this event)
- Fallback policy: if average P95 latency across requests goes above your SLO for >5 mins, requests are routed to a compatible lower-cost variant (Quant-8) with a max latency delta of +120ms and 25% lower per-token cost.

Commercial notes:
- If Bento prefers to pre-purchase additional headroom instead of sponsorship, we can invoice a discounted block at $0.012 / 1k tokens for the block (min 0.5M tokens).
- Sponsorship requires a one-page addendum (I attached a short summary) and sign-off from procurement/legal.

Next steps:
1) Confirm you want the sponsored credit vs. pre-purchase block.
2) If sponsored: we’ll prepare a 1-page addendum and apply it to your account; finance will reconcile as a credit post-window.
3) If pre-purchase: we’ll generate an invoice and reserve the capacity.

I’m copying Ben for any pricing flexibility and Marissa if we need exec sign-off for bigger sponsorships.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Attachments: ephemeral_headroom_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet, 22 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Erin Walsh <erin@bento-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-02T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity — temporary headroom ask

Erin —

We can do the sponsored credit at the amounts Ava outlined. Two quick clarifications from pricing:
- If Bento opts for repeated ephemeral events (3+ in a 90-day window) we’ll recommend moving to a short-term commit with graduated discounts (we can set the threshold).
- The one-off sponsorship is a courtesy for launch support; any overrun charge will be invoiced on the next billing cycle and can be paid via the card on file or net-30 invoicing (we’ll follow the existing billing terms).

If you want a slightly lower overrun rate in exchange for a brief marketing/partner co-sponsor mention, we can do $0.0125 / 1k.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

---
(Internal note: pushing to keep the sponsored credit under $20k commit equivalent unless Marissa signs off for higher.)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Erin Walsh <erin@bento-retail.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity — temporary headroom ask

Copying in Legal/Finance guidance: we approve a sponsored credit up to $18,000 for this launch provided Bento accepts these controls:
- Redwood applies the sponsored credit only to tokens consumed between the window timestamps.
- Any overrun beyond the sponsored amount will be billed at the agreed overrun rate (default $0.015 / 1k unless Bento accepts the co-sponsor rate).
- Bento agrees to a one-page addendum (we will attach to existing MLA) that includes the window and reconciliation terms.

Finance will need Bento’s PO or DocuSign acceptance on the addendum to reconcile the credit. I’ve asked ops to reserve the headroom in the orchestration layer once we have a signed addendum.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference

Ava / Ben / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Bento accepts the sponsored credit structure and the addendum terms. Legal will e-sign the one-page addendum (DocuSign link below) and Samir will confirm the usage profile next week so you can pre-warm caches.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/agree/RDW-8472-addendum
PO / Billing: contracts@bento-retail.com will follow with PO number in the next 24 hours.

Thanks everyone — this helps keep our commit unchanged while protecting the launch.

—Erin
